t: This is Mount Vernon House in Hampstead, a house listed Grade II since May 1974. It was built around 1726, and was altered in the early nineteenth century. It has stucco rendering and a mansard roof. The house stands on the site of a windmill. It was built between 1725 and 1728 by William Knight, a local Hampstead timbersmith. Later, the German inventor Isaac Lewis Pulvermacher, who lived from 1815 to 1884, lived here and died here.
